evals.prompt: Classify a contest problem about heat diffusion and material transport whose topic is initially unclear.
evals.expected_output: Success requires classifies into A/B/C/D/E; recommends method direction; flags physics keywords.
assertions: classifies the problem into exactly one of A/B/C/D/E
recommends a concrete method direction consistent with the topic
records the prior topic_type from problem-parser as preliminary rather than final
